# FAQ-026 Engineering FAQ #26

Revision: Rev A

Q1: What lubricant part should be used for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02)?
A1: Use lubricant part number CFW-LUB-195 for EQ-P1-L4-HP02. Refer to MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 for storage and handling specifics and ECN-2026-044 for the latest approved substitution guidance.

Q2: What is the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02)?
A2: Set mandrel clamp bolt torque to 475 N·m for EQ-P3-L2-RR02. Record the torque verification in the maintenance log per SOP-P3-L2-05 and reference ECN-2026-044 for any retrofit notes.

Q3: What lubricant part should be used for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01)?
A3: Use lubricant part number CFW-LUB-463 for EQ-P3-L2-SB01. Consult MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 for approved lubricant families and SOP-P3-L2-05 for application points and purge procedures.

Q4: What is the required coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P3-L1-IH03)?
A4: Maintain coil cooling water flow minimum at 65 L/min for EQ-P3-L1-IH03. Verify flow per SOP-P3-L2-05 and document any deviations; ECN-2026-044 contains instructions if system modifications affect flow.

Q5: What is the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01)?
A5: Set mandrel clamp bolt torque to 605 N·m for EQ-P3-L4-RR01. Torque checks must follow SOP-P3-L2-05 intervals and tooling references in MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2; log results and reference ECN-2026-044 if corrective action is required.

Related documents: ECN-2026-044, MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2, SOP-P3-L2-05
